subject: Enable tests to run with ASAN build. (#45)
reason: The change is purely build and CI infrastructure: it adds an opt-in ENABLE_ASAN CMake option and ASAN CI job, bumps pytest, adjusts the module's own integration-test teardown (FLUSHALL SYNC) and test-runner leak grep, and adds unit-test compile flags. No module source file (src/) changes, and the default build path emits the same compile/link flags as before, so the module binary at the change behaves identically to the parent's: there is no command, reply, persistence, replication or memory behaviour for a scenario to exercise.
